title: Add One Row to Tree
summary: Given a binary tree's root and integers val and depth, insert a new row of nodes with value val at the specified depth.
statement: Given a binary tree's root and integers val and depth, insert a new row of nodes with value val at the specified depth. For each non-null node at depth depth - 1, add two new nodes with value val as their children. The original left subtree becomes the left child of the new left node, and the original right subtree becomes the right child of the new right node. If depth is 1, create a new root with value val, making the original tree its left subtree.
constraints: The tree contains 1 to 10,000 nodes; 1 <= depth <= tree height + 1.
At depth one, the new node becomes root; otherwise preserve each original subtree under the correct new node.
